name: Rage
text:
- Rule Text: Imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage that grants extraordinary might and resilience. Number of uses per the Rages column; regain one expended use on a Short Rest and all uses on a Long Rest. While active, Rage provides: Damage Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; Rage Damage bonus (per Rage Damage column) to damage when you make an attack using Strength with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike and deal damage to the target; Strength Advantage (Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws); No Concentration or Spells (you can't maintain Concentration and can't cast spells). Rage lasts until the end of your next turn and ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the Incapacitated condition.
- Timing: Bonus Action (to enter; only if not wearing Heavy armor)
- Duration: Until end of next turn; extendable each round (up to 10 minutes) by making an attack roll against an enemy, forcing an enemy to make a saving throw, or taking a Bonus Action to extend it. Each extension lasts until the end of your next turn.
- Limits: Uses per Long Rest = Rages column (2–6 by level); regain 1 on Short Rest. Cannot enter while wearing Heavy armor. Ends if you don Heavy armor or become Incapacitated.
- Interactions: CLS-002 (Unarmored Defense), CLS-005 (Reckless Attack), CLS-013 (Brutal Strike), CLS-016 (Persistent Rage)
- Related Rules: CLS-012 (Instinctive Pounce), CLS-014 (Relentless Rage)

name: Unarmored Defense (Barbarian)
text:
- Rule Text: While not wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.
- Timing: Passive
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Weapon Mastery (Barbarian)
text:
- Rule Text: Use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice (e.g., Greataxes and Handaxes). When you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those weapon choices. The number of weapon kinds you can use mastery properties of increases per the Weapon Mastery column (2→3 at level 4; →4 at level 10).
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Number of weapon kinds = Weapon Mastery column. Change one choice per Long Rest.

name: Danger Sense
text:
- Rule Text: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Inactive while Incapacitated.

name: Reckless Attack
text:
- Rule Text: When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you Advantage on attack rolls using Strength until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage during that time.
- Timing: Triggered (first attack roll on your turn)
- Duration: Until the start of your next turn
- Interactions: CLS-013 (Brutal Strike), CLS-020 (Frenzy)

name: Primal Knowledge
text:
- Rule Text: Gain proficiency in another skill of your choice from the Barbarian level 1 skill list. In addition, while your Rage is active, you can channel primal power on certain ability checks: when you make an ability check using Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival, you can make it a Strength check even if it normally uses a different ability.
- Timing: Passive (skill); Triggered (ability check substitution, during Rage)
- Limits: Strength-substitution only while Rage is active.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Barbarian Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: Gain a Barbarian subclass of your choice (Path of the Berserker, Path of the Wild Heart, Path of the World Tree, or Path of the Zealot). You gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Barbarian level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Barbarian)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Gained again at Barbarian levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, 16.
- Related Rules: FEAT (Ability Score Improvement feat — Chapter 5)

name: Extra Attack (Barbarian)
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)

name: Fast Movement
text:
- Rule Text: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Only while not wearing Heavy armor.

name: Feral Instinct
text:
- Rule Text: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.
- Timing: Passive

name: Instinctive Pounce
text:
- Rule Text: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.
- Timing: Triggered (when entering Rage as a Bonus Action)
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Brutal Strike
text:
- Rule Text: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn. The chosen attack roll mustn't have Disadvantage. If the chosen attack roll hits, the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or Unarmed Strike, and you can cause one Brutal Strike effect of your choice:
  - Forceful Blow. The target is pushed 15 feet straight away from you. You can then move up to half your Speed straight toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
  - Hamstring Blow. The target's Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. A target can be affected by only one Hamstring Blow at a time — the most recent one.
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with the chosen attack, when using Reckless Attack)
- Limits: One chosen Strength-based attack roll per turn; that roll mustn't have Disadvantage; requires forgoing Advantage from Reckless Attack.
- Prerequisites: Must be using CLS-005 (Reckless Attack)
- Interactions: CLS-005 (Reckless Attack)
- Exceptions: CLS-015 (Improved Brutal Strike — adds options and uses)

name: Relentless Rage
text:
- Rule Text: If you drop to 0 Hit Points while your Rage is active and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, your Hit Points instead change to a number equal to twice your Barbarian level. Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. The DC resets to 10 when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
- Timing: Triggered (dropping to 0 HP during Rage)
- Limits: DC starts at 10, +5 each subsequent use; resets to 10 on a Short or Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Improved Brutal Strike
text:
- Rule Text: Level 13: Two new effects join your Brutal Strike options:
  - Staggering Blow. The target has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
  - Sundering Blow. Before the start of your next turn, the next attack roll made by another creature against the target gains a +5 bonus to the roll. An attack roll can gain only one Sundering Blow bonus.
  
  Level 17: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10. In addition, you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.
- Timing: Triggered (with Brutal Strike)
- Limits: Level 17 allows two different effects per Brutal Strike use; extra damage becomes 2d10.
- Prerequisites: CLS-013 (Brutal Strike)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-013 damage (2d10) and single-effect limit at level 17.

name: Persistent Rage
text:
- Rule Text: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage; after regaining uses this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. In addition, your Rage now lasts for 10 minutes without you needing to do anything to extend it from round to round. Your Rage ends early if you have the Unconscious condition (not just the Incapacitated condition) or don Heavy armor.
- Timing: Triggered (rolling Initiative) / Passive (extended duration)
- Duration: 10 minutes without extension.
- Limits: Initiative regain usable once per Long Rest.
- Exceptions: Modifies CLS-001 (Rage) duration and end conditions.

name: Indomitable Might
text:
- Rule Text: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
- Timing: Passive

name: Epic Boon (Barbarian)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: FEAT (Epic Boon feats — Chapter 5)

name: Primal Champion
text:
- Rule Text: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.
- Timing: Passive (level 20)

name: Frenzy (Berserker)
text:
- Rule Text: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike used for the attack.
- Timing: Triggered (first hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack, during Rage + Reckless Attack)
- Prerequisites: Level 3; CLS-001 (Rage) active; CLS-005 (Reckless Attack)
- Limits: Once per turn (first target hit).
- Interactions: CLS-005 (Reckless Attack), CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Mindless Rage (Berserker)
text:
- Rule Text: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.
- Timing: Passive (during Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Retaliation (Berserker)
text:
- Rule Text: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
- Timing: Reaction (triggered by taking damage from a creature within 5 feet)
- Prerequisites: Level 10

name: Intimidating Presence (Berserker)
text:
- Rule Text: Strike terror into others. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the Frightened creature's turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 1 minute (Frightened; save ends at end of each of the creature's turns)
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore its use.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage — can restore the use)

name: Animal Speaker (Wild Heart)
text:
- Rule Text: You can cast the *Beast Sense* and *Speak with Animals* spells, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.
- Timing: Action (Ritual casting only)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Related Rules: SPL (Beast Sense), SPL (Speak with Animals) — Chapter 7

name: Rage of the Wilds (Wild Heart)
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you activate your Rage, you gain one of the following options of your choice:
  - Bear. While your Rage is active, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.
  - Eagle. When you activate your Rage, you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of that Bonus Action. While your Rage is active, you can take a Bonus Action to take both of those actions.
  - Wolf. While your Rage is active, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy of yours within 5 feet of you.
- Timing: Triggered (on activating Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Aspect of the Wilds (Wild Heart)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain one of the following options of your choice; you can change it when you finish a Long Rest:
  - Owl. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.
  - Panther. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
  - Salmon. You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Change choice on a Long Rest.

name: Nature Speaker (Wild Heart)
text:
- Rule Text: You can cast the *Commune with Nature* spell, but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.
- Timing: Action (Ritual casting only)
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Related Rules: SPL (Commune with Nature) — Chapter 7

name: Power of the Wilds (Wild Heart)
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you activate your Rage, you gain one of the following options of your choice:
  - Falcon. While your Rage is active, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed if you aren't wearing any armor.
  - Lion. While your Rage is active, any of your enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian who has this option active.
  - Ram. While your Rage is active, you can cause a Large or smaller creature to have the Prone condition when you hit it with a melee attack.
- Timing: Triggered (on activating Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Vitality of the Tree (World Tree)
text:
- Rule Text: Your Rage taps into the life force of the World Tree, granting:
  - Vitality Surge. When you activate your Rage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level.
  - Life-Giving Force. At the start of each of your turns while your Rage is active, you can choose another creature within 10 feet of yourself to gain Temporary Hit Points. To determine the amount, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. If any of these Temporary Hit Points remain when your Rage ends, they vanish.
- Timing: Triggered (on activating Rage; start of each turn during Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Branches of the Tree (World Tree)
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you while your Rage is active, you can take a Reaction to summon spectral branches of the World Tree around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of yourself or in the nearest unoccupied space you can see. After the target teleports, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.
- Timing: Reaction (triggered when a visible creature starts its turn within 30 feet, during Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Battering Roots (World Tree)
text:
- Rule Text: During your turn, your reach is 10 feet greater with any Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property, as tendrils of the World Tree extend from you. When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with that weapon.
- Timing: Passive (your turn)
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Related Rules: EQP (Push mastery), EQP (Topple mastery) — Chapter 6

name: Travel along the Tree (World Tree)
text:
- Rule Text: When you activate your Rage and as a Bonus Action while your Rage is active, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. In addition, once per Rage, you can increase the range of that teleport to 150 feet; when you do so, you can also bring up to six willing creatures who are within 10 feet of you. Each creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination space.
- Timing: Triggered (on activating Rage) / Bonus Action (during Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Limits: 150-foot upgrade (with passengers) once per Rage.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Divine Fury (Zealot)
text:
- Rule Text: On each of your turns while your Rage is active, the first creature you hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 + half your Barbarian level (round down). The extra damage is Necrotic or Radiant; you choose the type each time you deal the damage.
- Timing: Triggered (first hit on each of your turns, during Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Once per turn (first creature hit).
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Warrior of the Gods (Zealot)
text:
- Rule Text: You have a pool of four d12s that you can spend to heal yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can expend dice from the pool, roll them, and regain Hit Points equal to the roll's total. The pool regains all expended dice when you finish a Long Rest. The pool's maximum number of dice increases by one at Barbarian levels 6 (5 dice), 12 (6 dice), and 17 (7 dice).
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Pool of d12s (4/5/6/7 by level 3/6/12/17); refills on a Long Rest.

name: Fanatical Focus (Zealot)
text:
- Rule Text: Once per active Rage, if you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and you must use the new roll.
- Timing: Triggered (on a failed saving throw, during Rage)
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Once per active Rage.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Zealous Presence (Zealot)
text:
- Rule Text: You unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: Until the start of your next turn
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore its use.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage — can restore the use)

name: Rage of the Gods (Zealot)
text:
- Rule Text: When you activate your Rage, you can assume the form of a divine warrior for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 Hit Points. While in this form you gain: Flight (a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you can hover); Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage; and Revivification — when a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to expend a use of your Rage to instead change the target's Hit Points to a number equal to your Barbarian level.
- Timing: Triggered (on activating Rage); Revivification is a Reaction
- Duration: 1 minute or until you drop to 0 HP
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, unless you expend a use of your Rage to do so again. Revivification expends a use of Rage per use.
- Interactions: CLS-001 (Rage)

name: Bardic Inspiration
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, inspire another creature within 60 feet of yourself who can see or hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die (a d6 at level 1; see Bardic Die column: d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, d12 at level 15). A creature can have only one Bardic Inspiration die at a time. Once within the next hour, when the creature fails a D20 Test, it can roll the die and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success. The die is expended when rolled.
- Timing: Bonus Action (to grant)
- Duration: The die lasts up to 1 hour or until expended
- Limits: Number of uses equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of once); regain all expended uses on a Long Rest. Recipient can hold only one die at a time.
- Interactions: CLS-107 (Font of Inspiration), CLS-110 (Superior Inspiration)
- Related Rules: CLS-113 (Dazzling Footwork), CLS-114 (Inspiring Movement), CLS-115 (Tandem Footwork), CLS-117 (Beguiling Magic), CLS-118 (Mantle of Inspiration), CLS-122 (Cutting Words), CLS-124 (Peerless Skill), CLS-125 (Combat Inspiration)

name: Spellcasting (Bard)
text:
- Rule Text: You can cast Bard spells (see chapter 7 for spellcasting rules; Bard spell list below). Cantrips: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Bard spell list (*Dancing Lights* and *Vicious Mockery* recommended); learn more per the Cantrips column (additional cantrips at levels 4 and 10). Whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one cantrip with another from the Bard spell list. Spell Slots: Use the Spell Slots columns of the Bard Features table; regain all expended slots on a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: Prepare spells available to cast equal to the Prepared Spells column; to start, choose four level 1 spells (*Charm Person*, *Color Spray*, *Dissonant Whispers*, *Healing Word* recommended). Prepared spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. Changing Prepared Spells: Whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Bard spell for which you have spell slots.
- Timing: Action (varies by spell)
- Limits: Spell slots per the Bard Features table; prepared spells per the Prepared Spells column.
- Interactions: CLS-109 (Magical Secrets), CLS-112 (Words of Creation), CLS-123 (Magical Discoveries)
- Related Rules: Spellcasting Ability is Charisma; you can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus. Bard Spell List (below).

name: Expertise (Bard)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice (Performance and Persuasion recommended if you have proficiency in them). At Bard level 9, you gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Two skills at level 2; two more at level 9.

name: Jack of All Trades
text:
- Rule Text: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn't otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.
- Timing: Passive

name: Bard Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Bard subclass of your choice: College of Dance, College of Glamour, College of Lore, or College of Valor. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Bard level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)
- Related Rules: CLS-113 to CLS-128 (subclass features)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Bard)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Bard levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, and 16.
- Related Rules: Ability Score Improvement feat (Chapter 5)

name: Font of Inspiration
text:
- Rule Text: You now regain all your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.
- Timing: Passive / Free (no action required) to spend a slot
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-101 recovery (now also on a Short Rest).

name: Countercharm
text:
- Rule Text: If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has Advantage.
- Timing: Reaction (triggered by a failed save vs. Charmed or Frightened within 30 feet)
- Interactions: Charmed condition, Frightened condition (Rules Glossary)

name: Magical Secrets
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you reach a Bard level (including this one) and the Prepared Spells number in the Bard Features table increases, you can choose any of your new prepared spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists, and the chosen spells count as Bard spells for you. In addition, whenever you replace a spell prepared for this class, you can replace it with a spell from those lists.
- Timing: Passive (on gaining Bard levels from level 10 onward)
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting)

name: Superior Inspiration
text:
- Rule Text: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two if you have fewer than that.
- Timing: Triggered (rolling Initiative)
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Epic Boon (Bard)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: Epic Boon feats (Chapter 5)

name: Words of Creation
text:
- Rule Text: You have mastered two of the Words of Creation: the words of life and death. You therefore always have the *Power Word Heal* and *Power Word Kill* spells prepared. When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.
- Timing: Passive (level 20)
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting)
- Related Rules: *Power Word Heal*, *Power Word Kill* (Chapter 7)

name: Dazzling Footwork
text:
- Rule Text: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you gain the following benefits: Dance Virtuoso — Advantage on any Charisma (Performance) check you make that involves you dancing. Unarmored Defense — your base Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier. Agile Strikes — when you expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that action, Bonus Action, or Reaction. Bardic Damage — you can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack rolls of your Unarmed Strikes; when you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Dexterity modifier, instead of the strike's normal damage (this roll doesn't expend the die).
- Prerequisites: Level 3; only while not wearing armor or wielding a Shield
- Timing: Passive (Unarmored Defense, Dance Virtuoso, Bardic Damage); Triggered (Agile Strikes, when expending Bardic Inspiration)
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Inspiring Movement
text:
- Rule Text: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction and expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed. Then one ally of your choice within 30 feet of you can also move up to half their Speed using their Reaction. None of this feature's movement provokes Opportunity Attacks.
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Timing: Reaction (triggered when a visible enemy ends its turn within 5 feet)
- Limits: Expends one use of Bardic Inspiration.
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Tandem Footwork
text:
- Rule Text: When you roll Initiative, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration if you don't have the Incapacitated condition. When you do so, roll your Bardic Inspiration die; you and each ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you gains a bonus to Initiative equal to the number rolled.
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Timing: Triggered (rolling Initiative)
- Limits: Expends one use of Bardic Inspiration; can't use while Incapacitated.
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Leading Evasion
text:
- Rule Text: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. If any creatures within 5 feet of you are making the same Dexterity saving throw, you can share this benefit with them for that save.
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Timing: Triggered (on a Dexterity save for half damage)
- Limits: You can't use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Beguiling Magic
text:
- Rule Text: You always have the *Charm Person* and *Mirror Image* spells prepared. In addition, immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can cause a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed or Frightened condition (your choice) for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Triggered (immediately after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot)
- Duration: 1 minute (save ends at end of each of the target's turns)
- Limits: Once per Long Rest; you can also restore its use by expending one use of your Bardic Inspiration (no action required).
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration), CLS-102 (Spellcasting); Charmed and Frightened conditions

name: Mantle of Inspiration
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die. Choose a number of other creatures within 60 feet of yourself, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of those creatures gains Temporary Hit Points equal to two times the number rolled on the Bardic Inspiration die, and then each can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Limits: Expends one use of Bardic Inspiration.
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Mantle of Majesty
text:
- Rule Text: You always have the *Command* spell prepared. As a Bonus Action, you cast *Command* without expending a spell slot, and you take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute or until your Concentration ends. During this time, you can cast *Command* as a Bonus Action without expending a spell slot. Any creature Charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against the *Command* you cast with this feature.
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 1 minute or until your Concentration ends
- Limits: Once per Long Rest; you can also restore its use by expending a level 3+ spell slot (no action required).
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting); Charmed condition
- Related Rules: *Command* (Chapter 7)

name: Unbreakable Majesty
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can assume a magically majestic presence for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. For the duration, whenever any creature hits you with an attack roll for the first time on a turn, the attacker must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, or the attack misses instead, as the creature recoils from your majesty.
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition
- Limits: Once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Bonus Proficiencies (Lore)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive

name: Cutting Words
text:
- Rule Text: When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll, reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Reaction (triggered by a visible creature's damage roll, or a successful ability check or attack roll, within 60 feet)
- Limits: Expends one use of Bardic Inspiration.
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Magical Discoveries
text:
- Rule Text: You learn two spells of your choice. These spells can come from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list or any combination thereof. A spell you choose must be a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots (per the Bard Features table). You always have the chosen spells prepared, and whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of the spells with another spell that meets these requirements.
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Timing: Passive
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting)

name: Peerless Skill
text:
- Rule Text: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Timing: Triggered (on your failed ability check or attack roll)
- Limits: Bardic Inspiration is expended only if the reroll succeeds.
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Combat Inspiration
text:
- Rule Text: A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can use it for one of the following effects: Defense — when the creature is hit by an attack roll, it can use its Reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss. Offense — immediately after the creature hits a target with an attack roll, it can roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the attack's damage against the target.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Reaction (Defense); Triggered (Offense, immediately after the creature hits)
- Interactions: CLS-101 (Bardic Inspiration)

name: Martial Training (Valor)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. In addition, you can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus to cast spells from your Bard spell list.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting)

name: Extra Attack (Bard)
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. In addition, you can cast one of your cantrips that has a casting time of an action in place of one of those attacks.
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting)

name: Battle Magic
text:
- Rule Text: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can make one attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action.
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Timing: Bonus Action (triggered after casting an action-cast spell)
- Interactions: CLS-102 (Spellcasting)

name: Spellcasting (Cleric)
text:
- Rule Text: You cast Cleric spells using the rules in chapter 7. Cantrips: You know three cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list; whenever you gain a Cleric level you can replace one cantrip with another from the Cleric spell list; at Cleric levels 4 and 10 you learn another cantrip (per the Cantrips column). Spell Slots: Use the Cleric Features table; regain all expended slots on a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: Prepare a list of level 1+ spells available to cast; to start, choose four level 1 spells from the Cleric spell list. The number of prepared spells increases per the Prepared Spells column; whenever it increases, choose additional Cleric spells until the list matches the table. Chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots (e.g., a level 3 Cleric's list can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination). Spells always prepared from another Cleric feature don't count against this number but otherwise count as Cleric spells for you. Changing Prepared Spells: When you finish a Long Rest, you can replace any prepared spells with other Cleric spells for which you have spell slots.
- Timing: Passive (preparation); spellcasting per individual spell
- Limits: Prepared spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots; change the list only on a Long Rest.
- Related Rules: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; you can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus; Cleric Spell List (this chapter)

name: Divine Order
text:
- Rule Text: Dedicate yourself to one sacred role of your choice:
  - Protector. You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.
  - Thaumaturge. You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list. In addition, you gain a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
- Timing: Passive (chosen at level 1)
- Interactions: CLS-201 (Spellcasting — extra cantrip)

name: Channel Divinity
text:
- Rule Text: Channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two effects: Divine Spark and Turn Undead. Each time you use Channel Divinity, choose which effect to create; you gain additional effect options at higher Cleric levels. You can use this class's Channel Divinity twice; regain one expended use on a Short Rest and all expended uses on a Long Rest. You gain additional uses at certain levels (per the Channel Divinity column). If a Channel Divinity effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals your Cleric spell save DC.
- Timing: Varies by effect (see options)
- Limits: Uses per the Channel Divinity column (2 at level 2, 3 at level 6, 4 at level 18); regain 1 on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-204 (Divine Spark), CLS-205 (Turn Undead), CLS-208 (Sear Undead)
- Related Rules: CLS-201 (Spellcasting — provides save DC)

name: Channel Divinity: Divine Spark
text:
- Rule Text: Point your Holy Symbol at another creature you can see within 30 feet and focus divine energy at it. Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier. You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total, or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw — on a failed save it takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total; on a successful save it takes half as much damage (round down). You roll an additional d8 at Cleric levels 7 (2d8), 13 (3d8), and 18 (4d8).
- Timing: Magic action
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity; range 30 feet.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity)

name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
text:
- Rule Text: Present your Holy Symbol and censure Undead creatures. Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute, and for that duration it tries to move as far from you as it can on its turns. The effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: 1 minute
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity; range 30 feet.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity), CLS-208 (Sear Undead)

name: Cleric Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Cleric subclass of your choice (Life Domain, Light Domain, Trickery Domain, or War Domain). A subclass grants features at certain Cleric levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Cleric level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Cleric)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Gained again at Cleric levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, 16.
- Related Rules: Ability Score Improvement feat (Chapter 5)

name: Sear Undead
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you use Turn Undead, you can roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1d8) and add the rolls together. Each Undead that fails its saving throw against that use of Turn Undead takes Radiant damage equal to the roll's total. This damage doesn't end the turn effect.
- Timing: Triggered (when using Turn Undead)
- Prerequisites: Level 5
- Interactions: CLS-205 (Turn Undead)

name: Blessed Strikes
text:
- Rule Text: You gain one of the following options of your choice (if you also get a Cleric subclass from an older book, use only the option you choose for this feature):
  - Divine Strike. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice).
  - Potent Spellcasting. Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Cleric cantrip.
- Timing: Triggered (Divine Strike, on a hit) / Passive (Potent Spellcasting)
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Limits: Divine Strike: once on each of your turns.
- Exceptions: CLS-211 (Improved Blessed Strikes) upgrades the chosen option

name: Divine Intervention
text:
- Rule Text: Choose any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of the same action, you cast that spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. You can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Limits: Once per Long Rest.
- Exceptions: CLS-213 (Greater Divine Intervention) extends spell choice to *Wish*

name: Improved Blessed Strikes
text:
- Rule Text: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful:
  - Divine Strike. The extra damage of your Divine Strike increases to 2d8.
  - Potent Spellcasting. When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself, granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.
- Timing: Triggered (Divine Strike, on a hit) / Triggered (Potent Spellcasting, on dealing cantrip damage)
- Prerequisites: Level 14; CLS-209 (Blessed Strikes)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-209 (raises Divine Strike to 2d8; adds Temporary HP to Potent Spellcasting)

name: Epic Boon (Cleric)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain an Epic Boon feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: Epic Boon feats (Chapter 5)

name: Greater Divine Intervention
text:
- Rule Text: When you use your Divine Intervention feature, you can choose *Wish* when you select a spell. If you do so, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.
- Timing: Passive (modifies Divine Intervention; level 20)
- Limits: Choosing *Wish* prevents reuse of Divine Intervention until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.
- Prerequisites: Level 20; CLS-210 (Divine Intervention)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-210 spell-level cap (allows *Wish*) and recharge

name: Disciple of Life
text:
- Rule Text: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.
- Timing: Triggered (when a slot-cast spell restores HP)
- Prerequisites: Level 3

name: Life Domain Spells
text:
- Rule Text: When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Prepared Spells |
|--------------|-----------------|
| 3 | Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration |
| 5 | Mass Healing Word, Revivify |
| 7 | Aura of Life, Death Ward |
| 9 | Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds |

- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-201 (Spellcasting — always-prepared spells don't count against prepared total)

name: Preserve Life
text:
- Rule Text: Present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Hit Points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity; targets only Bloodied creatures within 30 feet; can't raise a creature above half its HP maximum.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity)

name: Blessed Healer
text:
- Rule Text: Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.
- Timing: Triggered (after casting a slot-cast healing spell on others)
- Prerequisites: Level 6

name: Supreme Healing
text:
- Rule Text: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice; instead use the highest number possible for each die (e.g., instead of restoring 2d6, you restore 12).
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 17
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity), CLS-201 (Spellcasting)

name: Light Domain Spells
text:
- Rule Text: When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Light Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Prepared Spells |
|--------------|-----------------|
| 3 | Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility |
| 5 | Daylight, Fireball |
| 7 | Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire |
| 9 | Flame Strike, Scrying |

- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-201 (Spellcasting — always-prepared spells don't count against prepared total)

name: Radiance of the Dawn
text:
- Rule Text: Present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to emit a flash of light in a 30-foot Emanation originating from yourself. Any magical Darkness (such as that of the *Darkness* spell) in that area is dispelled. Additionally, each creature of your choice in that area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking Radiant damage equal to 2d10 plus your Cleric level on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity; 30-foot Emanation.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity)
- Related Rules: *Darkness* spell (Chapter 7)

name: Warding Flare
text:
- Rule Text: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that attack roll, causing light to flare before it hits or misses. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Reaction (triggered by an attack roll from a creature within 30 feet)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum once); regain all on a Long Rest.
- Exceptions: CLS-222 (Improved Warding Flare) changes recharge and adds Temporary HP

name: Improved Warding Flare
text:
- Rule Text: You regain all expended uses of your Warding Flare when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, whenever you use Warding Flare, you can give the target of the triggering attack a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 plus your Wisdom modifier.
- Timing: Triggered (with Warding Flare)
- Prerequisites: Level 6; CLS-221 (Warding Flare)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-221 recharge (now Short or Long Rest)

name: Corona of Light
text:
- Rule Text: Cause yourself to emit an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it (no action required). You emit Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Your enemies in the Bright Light have Disadvantage on saving throws against your Radiance of the Dawn and any spell that deals Fire or Radiant damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: 1 minute or until dismissed (no action required)
- Prerequisites: Level 17
- Limits: Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum once); regain all on a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-220 (Radiance of the Dawn)

name: Blessing of the Trickster
text:
- Rule Text: Choose yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of yourself to have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This blessing lasts until you finish a Long Rest or you use this feature again.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: Until you finish a Long Rest or use this feature again
- Prerequisites: Level 3

name: Invoke Duplicity
text:
- Rule Text: Expend one use of your Channel Divinity to create a perfect visual illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. It lasts for 1 minute, but ends early if you dismiss it (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. The illusion is animated and mimics your expressions and gestures. While it persists, you gain:
  - Cast Spells. You can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses.
  - Distract. When both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.
  - Move. As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is within 120 feet of yourself.
- Timing: Bonus Action (to create); Bonus Action (to move)
- Duration: 1 minute
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity; ends early if dismissed or you are Incapacitated.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity), CLS-227 (Trickster's Transposition)
- Exceptions: CLS-228 (Improved Duplicity) enhances it

name: Trickery Domain Spells
text:
- Rule Text: When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Trickery Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Prepared Spells |
|--------------|-----------------|
| 3 | Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace |
| 5 | Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection |
| 7 | Confusion, Dimension Door |
| 9 | Dominate Person, Modify Memory |

- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-201 (Spellcasting — always-prepared spells don't count against prepared total)

name: Trickster's Transposition
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you take the Bonus Action to create or move the illusion of your Invoke Duplicity, you can teleport, swapping places with the illusion.
- Timing: Triggered (with the Bonus Action to create/move the illusion)
- Prerequisites: Level 6; CLS-225 (Invoke Duplicity)
- Interactions: CLS-225 (Invoke Duplicity)

name: Improved Duplicity
text:
- Rule Text: The illusion of your Invoke Duplicity grows more powerful:
  - Shared Distraction. When you and your allies make attack rolls against a creature within 5 feet of the illusion, the attack rolls have Advantage.
  - Healing Illusion. When the illusion ends, you or a creature of your choice within 5 feet of it regains a number of Hit Points equal to your Cleric level.
- Timing: Passive / Triggered (Healing Illusion, when the illusion ends)
- Prerequisites: Level 17; CLS-225 (Invoke Duplicity)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-225 Distract (now allies benefit; no need to be adjacent yourself)

name: Guided Strike
text:
- Rule Text: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you misses with an attack roll, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity and give that roll a +10 bonus, potentially causing it to hit. When you use this feature to benefit another creature's attack roll, you must take a Reaction to do so.
- Timing: Triggered (on a missed attack roll); Reaction if benefiting another creature
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity; the other-creature use requires a Reaction; range 30 feet.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity)

name: War Domain Spells
text:
- Rule Text: When you reach a Cleric level specified in the War Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

| Cleric Level | Prepared Spells |
|--------------|-----------------|
| 3 | Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon |
| 5 | Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians |
| 7 | Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement |
| 9 | Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike |

- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-201 (Spellcasting — always-prepared spells don't count against prepared total)

name: War Priest
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Uses equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum once); regain all on a Short or Long Rest.

name: War God's Blessing
text:
- Rule Text: You can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to cast *Shield of Faith* or *Spiritual Weapon* rather than expending a spell slot. When you cast either spell this way, the spell doesn't require Concentration; instead the spell lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you cast that spell again, have the Incapacitated condition, or die.
- Timing: Triggered (when casting *Shield of Faith* or *Spiritual Weapon*)
- Duration: 1 minute (when cast via this feature)
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Expends a use of Channel Divinity.
- Interactions: CLS-203 (Channel Divinity)
- Related Rules: *Shield of Faith*, *Spiritual Weapon* (Chapter 7)

name: Avatar of Battle
text:
- Rule Text: You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 17

name: Spellcasting (Druid)
text:
- Rule Text: You cast Druid spells, which appear on the Druid spell list. Cantrips: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Druid spell list (Druidcraft and Produce Flame recommended). Whenever you gain a Druid level, you can replace one of your cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Druid spell list. At Druid levels 4 and 10 you learn another cantrip of your choice (per the Cantrips column). Spell Slots: The Druid Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells; you regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: To start, choose four level 1 spells from the Druid spell list (Animal Friendship, Cure Wounds, Faerie Fire, and Thunderwave recommended). The number of prepared spells increases per the Prepared Spells column; when it increases, choose additional spells from the Druid spell list until your list matches the table number. Chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots (e.g., a level 3 Druid's list can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination). Spells you always have prepared from another Druid feature don't count against this number but otherwise count as Druid spells for you. Changing Your Prepared Spells: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace any spells on your prepared list with other Druid spells for which you have spell slots. Spellcasting Ability: Wisdom. Spellcasting Focus: You can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells.
- Timing: Passive (spell preparation/changes on Long Rest); casting per spell
- Duration: Prepared list changes on each Long Rest; spell slots restored on Long Rest
- Limits: Prepared count = Prepared Spells column; cantrips known = Cantrips column; spell slots per the Druid Features table
- Related Rules: Druid Spell List (this file); Chapter 7 spellcasting rules; SPL (Druidcraft, Produce Flame)

name: Druidic
text:
- Rule Text: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. You also unlocked the magic of communicating with animals; you always have the *Speak with Animals* spell prepared. You can use Druidic to leave hidden messages. You and others who know Druidic automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check but can't decipher it without magic.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Deciphering a Druidic message without knowing Druidic requires magic; DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) only reveals its presence
- Interactions: CLS-301 (always-prepared *Speak with Animals*)
- Related Rules: SPL (Speak with Animals)

name: Primal Order
text:
- Rule Text: You dedicate yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice. Magician: You know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to nature gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum bonus of +1). Warden: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Choose one role
- Interactions: CLS-301 (Spellcasting (Druid))

name: Wild Shape
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you shape-shift into a Beast form you have learned for this feature. You stay in that form for a number of hours equal to half your Druid level or until you use Wild Shape again, have the Incapacitated condition, or die. You can also leave the form early as a Bonus Action. Number of Uses: You can use Wild Shape twice; you regain one expended use on a Short Rest and all expended uses on a Long Rest. You gain additional uses at certain Druid levels (per the Wild Shape column). Known Forms: You know four Beast forms, chosen from Beast stat blocks with a maximum Challenge Rating of 1/4 that lack a Fly Speed (see appendix B). The Rat, Riding Horse, Spider, and Wolf are recommended. On each Long Rest you can replace one known form with another eligible form. As you reach certain Druid levels, your number of known forms and the maximum Challenge Rating increase (per the Beast Shapes table); starting at level 8 you can adopt a form that has a Fly Speed. With DM permission you may look in the Monster Manual or elsewhere for eligible Beasts. Rules While Shape-Shifted: You retain your personality, memories, and ability to speak. *Temporary Hit Points:* When you assume a Wild Shape form, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Druid level. *Game Statistics:* Your game statistics are replaced by the Beast's stat block, but you retain your creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; class features; languages; and feats. You also retain your skill and saving throw proficiencies and use your Proficiency Bonus for them, in addition to gaining the creature's proficiencies; if a skill or saving throw modifier in the Beast's stat block is higher than yours, use the one in the stat block. *No Spellcasting:* You can't cast spells, but shape-shifting doesn't break your Concentration or otherwise interfere with a spell you've already cast. *Objects:* Your ability to handle objects is determined by the form's limbs. You choose whether your equipment falls in your space, merges into your new form, or is worn by it; worn equipment functions as normal (DM decides practicality by the form's size and shape); equipment doesn't change size or shape, and gear the form can't wear must fall to the ground or merge with the form (merged equipment has no effect while in that form).
- Timing: Bonus Action (to shape-shift; also to leave early)
- Duration: Hours equal to half your Druid level, or until you use Wild Shape again, become Incapacitated, or die
- Limits: Uses per the Wild Shape column (2 → 3 at level 6 → 4 at level 17); regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long Rest. Known forms/Max CR/Fly Speed per the Beast Shapes table
- Interactions: CLS-305 (Wild Companion), CLS-308 (Wild Resurgence), CLS-309 (Elemental Fury — Primal Strike), CLS-311 (Beast Spells), CLS-313 (Archdruid)
- Exceptions: CLS-311 (Beast Spells lets you cast in Beast form); CLS-319 (Circle Forms), CLS-321 (Improved Circle Forms) override CR/AC/damage type while shape-shifted
- Related Rules: Beast Shapes table (below); appendix B stat blocks

Beast Shapes

| Druid Level | Known Forms | Max CR | Fly Speed |
|-------------|-------------|--------|-----------|
| 2 | 4 | 1/4 | No |
| 4 | 6 | 1/2 | No |
| 8 | 8 | 1 | Yes |

name: Wild Companion
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast the *Find Familiar* spell without Material components. When cast this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: Until you finish a Long Rest
- Limits: Costs one spell slot or one use of Wild Shape per casting
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses)
- Related Rules: SPL (Find Familiar)

name: Druid Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Druid subclass of your choice: Circle of the Land, Circle of the Moon, Circle of the Sea, or Circle of the Stars. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Druid level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Druid)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Druid levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, 16
- Related Rules: FEAT (Ability Score Improvement feat — Chapter 5)

name: Wild Resurgence
text:
- Rule Text: Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot (no action required). In addition, you can expend one use of Wild Shape (no action required) to give yourself a level 1 spell slot, but you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: No action required (once on each of your turns for the spell-slot-to-Wild-Shape conversion)
- Limits: Spell-slot-to-Wild-Shape: once per turn and only when you have no Wild Shape uses left. Wild-Shape-to-level-1-slot: once per Long Rest
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses); CLS-301 (spell slots)

name: Elemental Fury
text:
- Rule Text: You gain one of the following options of your choice. Potent Spellcasting: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Druid cantrip. Primal Strike: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or a Beast form's attack in Wild Shape, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (choose when you hit).
- Timing: Passive (Potent Spellcasting) / Triggered (Primal Strike, on a hit, once per turn)
- Limits: Choose one option; Primal Strike usable once on each of your turns
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape attacks)
- Exceptions: CLS-310 (Improved Elemental Fury upgrades the chosen option)
- Related Rules: Druid cantrips (Druid Spell List)

name: Improved Elemental Fury
text:
- Rule Text: The option you chose for Elemental Fury grows more powerful. Potent Spellcasting: When you cast a Druid cantrip with a range of 10 feet or greater, the spell's range increases by 300 feet. Primal Strike: The extra damage of your Primal Strike increases to 2d8.
- Timing: Passive / Triggered (matches chosen Elemental Fury option)
- Prerequisites: CLS-309 (Elemental Fury)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-309 (Primal Strike damage → 2d8; cantrip range +300 ft)

name: Beast Spells
text:
- Rule Text: While using Wild Shape, you can cast spells in Beast form, except for any spell that has a Material component with a cost specified or that consumes its Material component.
- Timing: Passive (level 18)
- Limits: Excludes spells with a costed or consumed Material component
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape), CLS-301 (Spellcasting)
- Exceptions: Overrides the "No Spellcasting" rule of CLS-304

name: Epic Boon (Druid)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Dimensional Travel is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: FEAT (Epic Boon feats — Chapter 5)

name: Archdruid
text:
- Rule Text: Evergreen Wild Shape: Whenever you roll Initiative and have no uses of Wild Shape left, you regain one expended use of it. Nature Magician: You can convert uses of Wild Shape into a spell slot — choose a number of your unexpended uses of Wild Shape and convert them into a single spell slot, with each use contributing 2 spell levels (e.g., two uses produce a level 4 spell slot). Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. Longevity: For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year.
- Timing: Triggered (Evergreen Wild Shape, on rolling Initiative) / No action (Nature Magician) / Passive (Longevity)
- Limits: Nature Magician usable once per Long Rest
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses), CLS-308 (Wild Resurgence)

name: Circle of the Land Spells
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Consult the table that corresponds to the chosen type; you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared.
- Timing: Passive (choice on each Long Rest)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Land type chosen on each Long Rest; spells available for your Druid level and lower
- Interactions: CLS-316 (Natural Recovery), CLS-317 (Nature's Ward)

Arid Land

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
|-------------|---------------|
| 3 | Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt |
| 5 | Fireball |
| 7 | Blight |
| 9 | Wall of Stone |

Polar Land

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
|-------------|---------------|
| 3 | Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost |
| 5 | Sleet Storm |
| 7 | Ice Storm |
| 9 | Cone of Cold |

Temperate Land

| 5 | Stinking Cloud |
