name: Land's Aid
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Vitality-giving flowers and life-draining thorns appear for a moment in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points. The damage and healing increase by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Costs one use of Wild Shape; range 60 ft; 10-foot-radius Sphere
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses)

name: Natural Recovery
text:
- Rule Text: You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you do so again. In addition, when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover; the recovered slots can have a combined level equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+ (e.g., a level 6 Druid can recover up to three levels' worth of spell slots — a level 3 slot, or a level 2 and a level 1, or three level 1 slots). Once you recover spell slots with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Passive (free Circle spell cast) / Short Rest (slot recovery)
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Free Circle-spell cast once per Long Rest; slot recovery once per Long Rest, combined level ≤ half Druid level (round up), no slot level 6+
- Interactions: CLS-314 (Circle of the Land Spells), CLS-301 (spell slots)

name: Nature's Ward
text:
- Rule Text: You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice in the Circle Spells feature, as shown in the Nature's Ward table.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Interactions: CLS-314 (current land choice), CLS-318 (Nature's Sanctuary grants this Resistance to allies)

Nature's Ward

| Land Type | Resistance |
|-----------|------------|
| Arid | Fire |
| Polar | Cold |
| Temperate | Lightning |
| Tropical | Poison |

name: Nature's Sanctuary
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there. As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.
- Timing: Magic action (create) / Bonus Action (move)
- Duration: 1 minute, or until you are Incapacitated or die
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Limits: Costs one use of Wild Shape; 15-foot Cube within 120 ft; move up to 60 ft within 120 ft
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses), CLS-317 (Nature's Ward Resistance shared with allies)

name: Circle Forms
text:
- Rule Text: You can channel lunar magic when you assume a Wild Shape form, granting the benefits below. Challenge Rating: The maximum Challenge Rating for the form equals your Druid level divided by 3 (round down). Armor Class: Until you leave the form, your AC equals 13 plus your Wisdom modifier if that total is higher than the Beast's AC. Temporary Hit Points: You gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to three times your Druid level.
- Timing: Triggered (on assuming a Wild Shape form)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-304 Max CR and Temporary Hit Points while in a Circle Form

name: Circle of the Moon Spells
text:
- Rule Text: When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of the Moon Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. In addition, you can cast the spells from this feature while you're in a Wild Shape form.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape), CLS-301 (Spellcasting)

Circle of the Moon Spells

| Druid Level | Prepared Spells |
|-------------|-----------------|
| 3 | Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp |
| 5 | Conjure Animals |
| 7 | Fount of Moonlight |
| 9 | Mass Cure Wounds |

name: Improved Circle Forms
text:
- Rule Text: While in a Wild Shape form, you gain the following benefits. Lunar Radiance: Each of your attacks in a Wild Shape form can deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage; you make this choice each time you hit with those attacks. Increased Toughness: You can add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws.
- Timing: Passive (while in a Wild Shape form)
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape attacks/saves)

name: Moonlight Step
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, and you have Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of this turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also regain uses by expending a level 2+ spell slot for each use you want to restore (no action required).
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: Advantage lasts until the end of the current turn
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Limits: Uses = Wisdom modifier (min 1) per Long Rest; restore one use per level 2+ spell slot expended
- Interactions: CLS-323 (Lunar Form)

name: Lunar Form
text:
- Rule Text: Improved Lunar Radiance: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage to a target you hit with a Wild Shape form's attack. Shared Moonlight: Whenever you use Moonlight Step, you can also teleport one willing creature. That creature must be within 10 feet of you, and you teleport it to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of your destination space.
- Timing: Triggered (Improved Lunar Radiance, once per turn on a hit) / Triggered (Shared Moonlight, when you use Moonlight Step)
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Limits: Improved Lunar Radiance once per turn
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape attacks), CLS-322 (Moonlight Step)

name: Circle of the Sea Spells
text:
- Rule Text: When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of the Sea Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3

Circle of the Sea Spells

| Druid Level | Prepared Spells |
|-------------|-----------------|
| 3 | Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, Thunderwave |
| 5 | Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing |
| 7 | Control Water, Ice Storm |
| 9 | Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster |

name: Wrath of the Sea
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to manifest a 5-foot Emanation that takes the form of ocean spray that surrounds you for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), manifest it again, or have the Incapacitated condition. When you manifest the Emanation and as a Bonus Action on your subsequent turns, you can choose another creature you can see in the Emanation; the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or take Cold damage and, if the creature is Large or smaller, be pushed up to 15 feet away from you. To determine this damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die).
- Timing: Bonus Action (manifest; and on subsequent turns to target a creature)
- Duration: 10 minutes; ends early on dismiss, re-manifest, or Incapacitated
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Costs one use of Wild Shape; 5-foot Emanation; push up to 15 ft (Large or smaller); damage = Wis modifier d6s (min 1 die)
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses)
- Exceptions: CLS-326 (Aquatic Affinity enlarges to 10 ft); CLS-327 (Stormborn adds benefits); CLS-328 (Oceanic Gift redirects/duplicates)

name: Aquatic Affinity
text:
- Rule Text: The size of the Emanation created by your Wrath of the Sea increases to 10 feet. In addition, you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Interactions: CLS-325 (Wrath of the Sea)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-325 Emanation size (→ 10 ft)

name: Stormborn
text:
- Rule Text: Your Wrath of the Sea confers two more benefits while active. Flight: You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Resistance: You have Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.
- Timing: Passive (while Wrath of the Sea is active)
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Interactions: CLS-325 (Wrath of the Sea)

name: Oceanic Gift
text:
- Rule Text: Instead of manifesting the Emanation of Wrath of the Sea around yourself, you can manifest it around one willing creature within 60 feet of yourself; that creature gains all the benefits of the Emanation and uses your spell save DC and Wisdom modifier for it. In addition, you can manifest the Emanation around both the other creature and yourself if you expend two uses of your Wild Shape instead of one when manifesting it.
- Timing: Triggered (when manifesting Wrath of the Sea)
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Limits: Target willing creature within 60 ft; manifesting on both self and another costs two uses of Wild Shape
- Interactions: CLS-325 (Wrath of the Sea), CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses)

name: Star Map
text:
- Rule Text: You've created a star chart, a Tiny object you can use as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells. Determine its form by rolling on the Star Map table or by choosing one. While holding the map, you have the *Guidance* and *Guiding Bolt* spells prepared, and you can cast *Guiding Bolt* without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once); you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony (during a Short or Long Rest) to magically create a replacement, which destroys the previous map.
- Timing: Passive (prepared spells / focus) / 1-hour ceremony to replace
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Free *Guiding Bolt* casts = Wisdom modifier (min 1) per Long Rest
- Interactions: CLS-331 (Cosmic Omen consults the Star Map)
- Related Rules: SPL (Guidance, Guiding Bolt)

Star Map

| 1d6 | Map Form |
|-----|----------|
| 1 | A scroll bearing depictions of constellations |
| 2 | A stone tablet with fine holes drilled through it |
| 3 | An owlbear hide tooled with stellar symbols |
| 4 | A collection of maps bound in an ebony cover |
| 5 | A crystal engraved with starry patterns |
| 6 | A glass disk etched with constellations |

name: Starry Form
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form rather than shape-shifting. While in your starry form, you retain your game statistics, but your body becomes luminous, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. The form lasts for 10 minutes; it ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), have the Incapacitated condition, or use this feature again. Whenever you assume your starry form, choose which constellation glimmers on your body: Archer: When you activate this form and as a Bonus Action on your subsequent turns while it lasts, you can make a ranged spell attack, hurling a luminous arrow that targets one creature within 60 feet of yourself; on a hit, it deals Radiant damage equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier. Chalice: Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores Hit Points to a creature, you or another creature within 30 feet of you can regain Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier. Dragon: When you make an Intelligence or a Wisdom check or a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.
- Timing: Bonus Action (assume; Archer also Bonus Action on subsequent turns)
- Duration: 10 minutes; ends early on dismiss, Incapacitated, or reuse
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Costs one use of Wild Shape; choose one constellation per activation
- Interactions: CLS-304 (Wild Shape uses)
- Exceptions: CLS-332 (Twinkling Constellations upgrades dice and adds flight); CLS-333 (Full of Stars adds Resistance)

name: Cosmic Omen
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can consult your Star Map for omens and roll a die. Until you finish your next Long Rest, you gain access to a special Reaction based on whether you rolled an even or odd number: Weal (Even): Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and add the number rolled to the total. Woe (Odd): Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and subtract the number rolled from the total. You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Reaction (triggered when a creature within 30 ft is about to make a D20 Test); die roll on Long Rest
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Uses = Wisdom modifier (min 1) per Long Rest
- Interactions: CLS-329 (Star Map)

name: Twinkling Constellations
text:
- Rule Text: The 1d8 of the Archer and the Chalice becomes 2d8, and while the Dragon is active, you have a Fly Speed of 20 feet and can hover. Moreover, at the start of each of your turns while in your Starry Form, you can change which constellation glimmers on your body.
- Timing: Passive / Triggered (change constellation at the start of each of your turns)
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Interactions: CLS-330 (Starry Form)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-330 (Archer/Chalice dice → 2d8; Dragon grants 20-ft Fly Speed)

name: Full of Stars
text:
- Rule Text: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
- Timing: Passive (while in Starry Form)
- Prerequisites: Level 14
- Interactions: CLS-330 (Starry Form)

name: Fighting Style
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see chapter 5). Defense is recommended. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 1)
- Limits: May swap for a different Fighting Style feat whenever you gain a Fighter level.
- Related Rules: FEAT (Fighting Style feats — Chapter 5)

name: Second Wind
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can use it to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter Features table.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Limits: Uses per the Second Wind column (2 at level 1; 3 at level 4; 4 at level 10). Regain 1 use on a Short Rest; all uses on a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-405 (Tactical Mind), CLS-409 (Tactical Shift)

name: Weapon Mastery (Fighter)
text:
- Rule Text: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices. When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Fighter Features table.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Number of weapon kinds = Weapon Mastery column (3 at level 1; 4 at level 4; 5 at level 10; 6 at level 16). Change one choice per Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-411 (Tactical Master)

name: Action Surge
text:
- Rule Text: On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Magic action. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.
- Timing: Free (extra action on your turn)
- Limits: Once per Short or Long Rest (two uses starting at level 17, but only once per turn). Cannot be used for the Magic action.
- Interactions: CLS-452 (Arcane Charge)

name: Tactical Mind
text:
- Rule Text: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining Hit Points, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.
- Timing: Triggered (on a failed ability check)
- Limits: Expends a use of Second Wind only if the check then succeeds; if it still fails, the use isn't expended.
- Interactions: CLS-402 (Second Wind)

name: Fighter Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice (Battle Master, Champion, Eldritch Knight, or Psi Warrior). A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Fighter levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Fighter level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Fighter)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Fighter levels 6, 8, 12, 14, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 6, 8, 12, 14, and 16.
- Related Rules: FEAT (Ability Score Improvement feat — Chapter 5)

name: Extra Attack (Fighter)
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)
- Exceptions: CLS-412 (Two Extra Attacks), CLS-415 (Three Extra Attacks)

name: Tactical Shift
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you activate your Second Wind with a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Timing: Triggered (when activating Second Wind with a Bonus Action)
- Interactions: CLS-402 (Second Wind)

name: Indomitable
text:
- Rule Text: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest. You can use this feature twice before a Long Rest starting at level 13 and three times before a Long Rest starting at level 17.
- Timing: Triggered (on a failed saving throw)
- Limits: Uses per Long Rest: one at level 9; two at level 13; three at level 17. Must use the new roll.

name: Tactical Master
text:
- Rule Text: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.
- Timing: Triggered (per attack with a mastery-eligible weapon)
- Interactions: CLS-403 (Weapon Mastery)
- Related Rules: EQP (Push mastery), EQP (Sap mastery), EQP (Slow mastery) — Chapter 6

name: Two Extra Attacks
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack three times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-408 (Extra Attack); overridden by CLS-415 (Three Extra Attacks)

name: Studied Attacks
text:
- Rule Text: If you make an attack roll against a creature and miss, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
- Timing: Triggered (on a missed attack roll)
- Duration: Until the end of your next turn

name: Epic Boon (Fighter)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Combat Prowess is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: FEAT (Epic Boon feats — Chapter 5)

name: Three Extra Attacks
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack four times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-408 (Extra Attack) and CLS-412 (Two Extra Attacks)

name: Combat Superiority
text:
- Rule Text: You learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called Superiority Dice. Maneuvers: You learn three maneuvers of your choice from the Maneuver Options. Many maneuvers enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one maneuver per attack. You learn two additional maneuvers of your choice when you reach Fighter levels 7, 10, and 15. Each time you learn new maneuvers, you can also replace one maneuver you know with a different one. Superiority Dice: You have four Superiority Dice, which are d8s. A Superiority Die is expended when you use it. You regain all expended Superiority Dice when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You gain an additional Superiority Die when you reach Fighter levels 7 (five dice total) and 15 (six dice total). Saving Throws: If a maneuver requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) and Proficiency Bonus.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive (maneuvers triggered per their own descriptions)
- Limits: Maneuvers known: 3 at level 3; +2 each at levels 7, 10, and 15 (9 total). Only one maneuver per attack. Superiority Dice: 4 (d8) at level 3; 5 at level 7; 6 at level 15. Regain all on a Short or Long Rest. Maneuver save DC = 8 + Str or Dex modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
- Interactions: CLS-418 (Know Your Enemy), CLS-419 (Improved Combat Superiority), CLS-420 (Relentless), CLS-421 (Ultimate Combat Superiority), CLS-422 through CLS-441 (Trip Attack (Maneuver))

name: Student of War
text:
- Rule Text: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the skills available to Fighters at level 1.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive

name: Know Your Enemy
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can discern certain strengths and weaknesses of a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself; you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Limits: Once per Long Rest; can also restore a use by expending one Superiority Die (no action required).
- Interactions: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)

name: Improved Combat Superiority
text:
- Rule Text: Your Superiority Die becomes a d10.
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Timing: Passive
- Exceptions: Overrides Superiority Die size in CLS-416; overridden by CLS-421 (Ultimate Combat Superiority)

name: Relentless
text:
- Rule Text: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use the number rolled instead of expending a Superiority Die.
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Timing: Triggered (when you use a maneuver)
- Limits: Once per turn.
- Interactions: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)

name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
text:
- Rule Text: Your Superiority Die becomes a d12.
- Prerequisites: Level 18
- Timing: Passive
- Exceptions: Overrides Superiority Die size in CLS-416 and CLS-419

name: Ambush (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll, unless you have the Incapacitated condition.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a Dexterity (Stealth) check or Initiative roll)
- Limits: Cannot use while Incapacitated.

name: Bait and Switch (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and the creature is willing and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Roll the Superiority Die. Until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on your turn, within 5 feet of the creature)
- Duration: AC bonus until the start of your next turn
- Limits: Requires at least 5 feet of movement; the creature must be willing and not Incapacitated.

name: Commander's Strike (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a willing creature who can see or hear you and expend one Superiority Die. That creature can immediately use its Reaction to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, adding the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll on a hit.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (replaces one attack of the Attack action)
- Interactions: CLS-408 (Extra Attack)

name: Commanding Presence (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the roll.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check)

name: Disarming Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to disarm the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in its space.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an attack roll)

name: Distracting Strike (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has Advantage if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an attack roll)
- Duration: Until the start of your next turn

name: Evasive Footwork (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Disengage action. You also roll the die and add the number rolled to your AC until the start of your next turn.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: AC bonus until the start of your next turn

name: Feinting Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of yourself as your target. You have Advantage on your next attack roll against that target this turn. If that attack hits, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: Advantage on your next attack roll against that target this turn

name: Goading Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an attack roll)
- Duration: Until the end of your next turn (on a failed save)

name: Lunging Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 5 feet in a straight line immediately before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on this turn, you can add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Bonus Action

name: Maneuvering Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into another position. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll, and choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target of your attack.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an attack roll)

name: Menacing Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to frighten the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an attack roll)
- Duration: Until the end of your next turn (on a failed save)

name: Parry (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When another creature damages you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your Superiority Die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Reaction (when a creature damages you with a melee attack roll)

name: Precision Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll that die, and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a missed attack roll)

name: Pushing Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to drive the target back. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from you.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike)

name: Rally (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion. Choose an ally of yours within 30 feet of yourself who can see or hear you. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Superiority Die roll plus half your Fighter level (round down).
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Bonus Action

name: Riposte (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack roll with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the creature. If you hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Reaction (when a creature misses you with a melee attack roll)

name: Sweeping Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to damage another creature. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your Superiority Die. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike)

name: Tactical Assessment (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on an Intelligence (History or Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check)

name: Trip Attack (Maneuver)
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the attack's damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.
- Prerequisites: CLS-416 (Combat Superiority)
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike)

name: Improved Critical
text:
- Rule Text: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive
- Exceptions: Overridden by CLS-446 (Superior Critical)

name: Remarkable Athlete
text:
- Rule Text: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive (Advantage); Triggered (movement after a Critical Hit)

name: Additional Fighting Style
text:
- Rule Text: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Timing: Passive
- Related Rules: FEAT (Fighting Style feats — Chapter 5); CLS-401 (Fighting Style)

name: Heroic Warrior
text:
- Rule Text: During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Timing: Triggered (start of your turn, during combat, when you lack Heroic Inspiration)

name: Superior Critical
text:
- Rule Text: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Timing: Passive
- Exceptions: Overrides CLS-442 (Improved Critical)

name: Survivor
text:
- Rule Text: You gain these benefits: Defy Death. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Moreover, when you roll 18–20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it. Heroic Rally. At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.
- Prerequisites: Level 18
- Timing: Passive (Defy Death); Triggered (Heroic Rally at the start of each of your turns)
- Limits: Heroic Rally requires you to be Bloodied and at 1+ Hit Points.

name: Spellcasting (Eldritch Knight)
text:
- Rule Text: You have learned to cast spells (see chapter 7 for spellcasting rules). Cantrips: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list. Ray of Frost and Shocking Grasp are recommended. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list. When you reach Fighter level 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice. Spell Slots: The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: To start, choose three level 1 spells from the Wizard spell list. Burning Hands, Jump, and Shield are recommended. The number of spells on your list increases per the Prepared Spells column; whenever it increases, choose additional spells from the Wizard spell list. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots (e.g., at level 7 your list can include five Wizard spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination). Changing Your Prepared Spells: Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Wizard spell for which you have spell slots. Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells. Spellcasting Focus: You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive (spell preparation); spells cast per their own casting times
- Limits: Cantrips known: 2 at level 3; 3 at level 10. Prepared level 1+ spells and spell slots per the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table. Regain all spell slots on a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-450 (War Magic), CLS-451 (Eldritch Strike), CLS-453 (Improved War Magic)
- Related Rules: Wizard spell list (by name); Spellcasting rules — Chapter 7

name: War Bond
text:
- Rule Text: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a Short Rest. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond. The bond fails if another Fighter is bonded to the weapon or if the weapon is a magic item to which someone else is attuned. Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you have the Incapacitated condition. If it's on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a Bonus Action, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand. You can have up to two bonded weapons, but you can summon only one at a time as a Bonus Action. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Ritual (1 hour, can be during a Short Rest); Bonus Action (to summon a bonded weapon)
- Limits: Up to two bonded weapons; summon only one at a time.

name: War Magic
text:
- Rule Text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a casting of one of your Wizard cantrips that has a casting time of an action.
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Timing: Triggered (replaces one attack of the Attack action)
- Interactions: CLS-448 (Spellcasting)
- Exceptions: Overridden by CLS-453 (Improved War Magic)

name: Eldritch Strike
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
- Prerequisites: Level 10
- Timing: Triggered (on a weapon hit)
- Duration: Applies to the next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn
- Interactions: CLS-448 (Spellcasting)

name: Arcane Charge
text:
- Rule Text: When you use your Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can teleport before or after the additional action.
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Timing: Triggered (when you use Action Surge)
- Interactions: CLS-404 (Action Surge)

name: Improved War Magic
text:
- Rule Text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace two of the attacks with a casting of one of your level 1 or level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.
- Prerequisites: Level 18
- Timing: Triggered (replaces two attacks of the Attack action)
- Interactions: CLS-448 (Spellcasting)
- Exceptions: Extends CLS-450 (War Magic)

name: Psionic Power (Psi Warrior)
text:
- Rule Text: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself, represented by your Psionic Energy Dice. The Psi Warrior Energy Dice table shows the die size and number of these dice you have at certain Fighter levels. Any features in this subclass that use a Psionic Energy Die use only the dice from this subclass. Some of your powers expend the Psionic Energy Die, as specified in a power's description, and you can't use a power if it requires you to use a die when all your Psionic Energy Dice are expended. You regain one of your expended Psionic Energy Dice when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all of them when you finish a Long Rest. You gain the powers Protective Field, Psionic Strike, and Telekinetic Movement.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive (resource; individual powers per their own timing)
- Limits: Regain one Psionic Energy Die on a Short Rest; all on a Long Rest. Cannot use a power requiring a die when all are expended.
- Interactions: CLS-455 (Protective Field), CLS-456 (Psionic Strike), CLS-457 (Telekinetic Movement), CLS-458 (Telekinetic Adept), CLS-459 (Guarded Mind), CLS-460 (Bulwark of Force), CLS-461 (Telekinetic Master)
