name: Protective Field (Psionic Power)
text:
- Rule Text: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can take a Reaction to expend one Psionic Energy Die, roll the die, and reduce the damage taken by the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum reduction of 1), as you create a momentary shield of telekinetic force.
- Prerequisites: Level 3; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Reaction (when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage)
- Limits: Minimum reduction of 1. Expends one Psionic Energy Die.

name: Psionic Strike (Psionic Power)
text:
- Rule Text: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you hit a target within 30 feet of yourself with an attack and deal damage to it with a weapon, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die, rolling it and dealing Force damage to the target equal to the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.
- Prerequisites: Level 3; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Triggered (once on each of your turns, after a weapon hit within 30 feet)
- Limits: Once per turn. Expends one Psionic Energy Die.
- Interactions: CLS-458 (Telekinetic Adept)

name: Telekinetic Movement (Psionic Power)
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, choose one target you can see within 30 feet of yourself; the target must be a loose object that is Large or smaller or one willing creature other than you. You transport the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, if the target is a Tiny object, you can transport it to or from your hand.
- Prerequisites: Level 3; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Magic action
- Limits: Once per Short or Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

name: Telekinetic Adept
text:
- Rule Text: Psi-Powered Leap. As a Bonus Action, you gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed until the end of the current turn. Once you take this Bonus Action, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it. Telekinetic Thrust. When you deal damage to a target with your Psionic Strike, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you can give the target the Prone condition or transport it up to 10 feet horizontally.
- Prerequisites: Level 7; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Bonus Action (Psi-Powered Leap); Triggered (Telekinetic Thrust, on dealing Psionic Strike damage)
- Duration: Psi-Powered Leap Fly Speed until the end of the current turn
- Limits: Psi-Powered Leap once per Short or Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore its use.
- Interactions: CLS-456 (Psionic Strike)

name: Guarded Mind
text:
- Rule Text: You have Resistance to Psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn with the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) and end every effect on yourself giving you those conditions.
- Prerequisites: Level 10; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Passive (Resistance); Triggered (start of your turn, if Charmed or Frightened)

name: Bulwark of Force
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can choose creatures, including yourself, within 30 feet of yourself, up to a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures has Half Cover for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition.
- Prerequisites: Level 15; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

name: Telekinetic Master
text:
- Rule Text: You always have the Telekinesis spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or components, and your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence. On each of your turns while you maintain Concentration on it, including the turn when you cast it, you can make one attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action.
- Prerequisites: Level 18; CLS-454 (Psionic Power)
- Timing: Action (cast Telekinesis); Bonus Action (weapon attack while concentrating)
- Duration: While you maintain Concentration on Telekinesis
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.
- Related Rules: SPL (Telekinesis) — Chapter 7

name: Martial Arts
text:
- Rule Text: Gives mastery of combat styles that use your Unarmed Strike and Monk weapons. Monk weapons are: Simple Melee weapons, and Martial Melee weapons that have the Light property. You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield: Bonus Unarmed Strike — you can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. Martial Arts Die — you can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons; this die changes as you gain Monk levels, per the Martial Arts column. Dexterous Attacks — you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons; in addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.
- Timing: Passive; Bonus Unarmed Strike is a Bonus Action.
- Limits: Benefits apply only while unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons, and not wearing armor or wielding a Shield. Martial Arts die scales per the Martial Arts column (1d6 → 1d8 at level 5 → 1d10 at level 11 → 1d12 at level 17).
- Interactions: CLS-502 (Unarmored Defense), CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Unarmored Defense (Monk)
text:
- Rule Text: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Only while not wearing armor and not wielding a Shield.

name: Monk's Focus
text:
- Rule Text: Your focus and martial training let you harness extraordinary energy represented by Focus Points. Your Monk level determines the number of points you have (Focus Points column). You can expend these points to enhance or fuel certain Monk features. You start knowing three such features: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. When you expend a Focus Point, it is unavailable until you finish a Short or Long Rest, at the end of which you regain all your expended points. Some features that use Focus Points require your target to make a saving throw; the save DC equals 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and Proficiency Bonus.
  - Flurry of Blows. Expend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.
  - Patient Defense. Take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action. Alternatively, expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and the Dodge actions as a Bonus Action.
  - Step of the Wind. Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. Alternatively, expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dash actions as a Bonus Action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.
- Timing: Passive (resource); Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind are each a Bonus Action.
- Duration: Expended points unavailable until a Short or Long Rest.
- Limits: Focus Points available = Focus Points column (2–20 by level). Focus save DC = 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
- Interactions: CLS-505 (Uncanny Metabolism), CLS-515 (Heightened Focus), CLS-519 (Perfect Focus)
- Exceptions: CLS-515 (Heightened Focus) upgrades Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind.

name: Unarmored Movement
text:
- Rule Text: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain Monk levels, as shown on the Monk Features table (Unarmored Movement column).
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Only while not wearing armor and not wielding a Shield. Bonus scales: +10 ft. (level 2) → +15 ft. (6) → +20 ft. (10) → +25 ft. (14) → +30 ft. (18).

name: Uncanny Metabolism
text:
- Rule Text: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended Focus Points. When you do so, roll your Martial Arts die and regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Monk level plus the number rolled.
- Timing: Triggered (when you roll Initiative)
- Limits: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus), CLS-519 (Perfect Focus)

name: Deflect Attacks
text:
- Rule Text: When an attack roll hits you and its damage includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce the attack's total damage against you. The reduction equals 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier and Monk level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can expend 1 Focus Point to redirect some of the attack's force: choose a creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself if the attack was a melee attack, or a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn't behind Total Cover if the attack was a ranged attack. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die plus your Dexterity modifier. The damage is the same type dealt by the attack.
- Timing: Reaction (when an attack roll hits you with Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage)
- Limits: Redirect requires reducing the damage to 0 and expending 1 Focus Point.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)
- Exceptions: CLS-517 (Deflect Energy) extends this to any damage type.

name: Monk Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: Gain a Monk subclass of your choice (Warrior of Mercy, Warrior of Shadow, Warrior of the Elements, or Warrior of the Open Hand). For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Monk level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Monk)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Monk levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, and 16.
- Related Rules: Ability Score Improvement feat (Chapter 5)

name: Slow Fall
text:
- Rule Text: You can take a Reaction when you fall to reduce any damage you take from the fall by an amount equal to five times your Monk level.
- Timing: Reaction (when you fall)

name: Extra Attack (Monk)
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)

name: Stunning Strike
text:
- Rule Text: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a Monk weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 1 Focus Point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target's Speed is halved until the start of your next turn, and the next attack roll made against the target before then has Advantage.
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike)
- Duration: Until the start of your next turn
- Limits: Once per turn; costs 1 Focus Point. (Stunned condition — see core rules.)
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Empowered Strikes
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.
- Timing: Passive (when you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike)

name: Evasion (Monk)
text:
- Rule Text: When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You don't benefit from this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.
- Timing: Triggered (when you make a Dexterity save for half damage)
- Limits: Inactive while you have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Acrobatic Movement
text:
- Rule Text: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the movement.
- Timing: Passive (on your turn)
- Limits: Only while not wearing armor and not wielding a Shield.

name: Heightened Focus
text:
- Rule Text: Your Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind gain the following benefits.
  - Flurry of Blows. You can expend 1 Focus Point to use Flurry of Blows and make three Unarmed Strikes with it instead of two.
  - Patient Defense. When you expend a Focus Point to use Patient Defense, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die.
  - Step of the Wind. When you expend a Focus Point to use Step of the Wind, you can choose a willing creature within 5 feet of yourself that is Large or smaller. You move the creature with you until the end of your turn. The creature's movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Timing: Passive (modifies CLS-503 features)
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)
- Exceptions: Overrides the base Flurry of Blows / Patient Defense / Step of the Wind behavior in CLS-503.

name: Self-Restoration
text:
- Rule Text: Through sheer force of will, you can remove one of the following conditions from yourself at the end of each of your turns: Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned. In addition, forgoing food and drink doesn't give you levels of Exhaustion.
- Timing: Triggered (end of each of your turns)
- Limits: Remove one of the listed conditions per turn.

name: Deflect Energy
text:
- Rule Text: You can now use your Deflect Attacks feature against attacks that deal any damage type, not just Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing.
- Timing: Reaction (as Deflect Attacks)
- Prerequisites: CLS-506 (Deflect Attacks)
- Exceptions: Overrides the damage-type restriction in CLS-506 (Deflect Attacks).

name: Disciplined Survivor
text:
- Rule Text: Your physical and mental discipline grant you proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll it, and you must use the new roll.
- Timing: Passive; reroll is Triggered (on a failed saving throw)
- Limits: Reroll costs 1 Focus Point.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Perfect Focus
text:
- Rule Text: When you roll Initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain expended Focus Points until you have 4 if you have 3 or fewer.
- Timing: Triggered (when you roll Initiative)
- Limits: Only if you have 3 or fewer Focus Points and don't use Uncanny Metabolism.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus), CLS-505 (Uncanny Metabolism)

name: Superior Defense
text:
- Rule Text: At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Focus Points to bolster yourself against harm for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have Resistance to all damage except Force damage.
- Timing: Triggered (start of your turn)
- Duration: 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition
- Limits: Costs 3 Focus Points.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Epic Boon (Monk)
text:
- Rule Text: Gain an Epic Boon feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: Epic Boon feats (Chapter 5)

name: Body and Mind
text:
- Rule Text: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.
- Timing: Passive (level 20)

name: Hand of Harm
text:
- Rule Text: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can expend 1 Focus Point to deal extra Necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an Unarmed Strike that deals damage)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Once per turn; costs 1 Focus Point.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)
- Exceptions: CLS-526 (Physician's Touch) and CLS-527 (Flurry of Healing and Harm) modify it.

name: Hand of Healing
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and restore a number of Hit Points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of this feature without expending a Focus Point for the healing.
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Costs 1 Focus Point (waived when replacing a Flurry of Blows strike).
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)
- Exceptions: CLS-526 (Physician's Touch) and CLS-527 (Flurry of Healing and Harm) modify it.

name: Implements of Mercy
text:
- Rule Text: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills and proficiency with the Herbalism Kit.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3

name: Physician's Touch
text:
- Rule Text: Your Hand of Harm and Hand of Healing improve. Hand of Harm. When you use Hand of Harm on a creature, you can also give that creature the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. Hand of Healing. When you use Hand of Healing, you can also end one of the following conditions on the creature you heal: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.
- Timing: Passive (modifies CLS-523 and CLS-524)
- Prerequisites: Level 6; CLS-523 (Hand of Harm), CLS-524 (Hand of Healing)
- Interactions: CLS-523 (Hand of Harm), CLS-524 (Hand of Healing)

name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
text:
- Rule Text: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without expending Focus Points for the healing. In addition, when you make an Unarmed Strike with Flurry of Blows and deal damage, you can use Hand of Harm with that strike without expending a Focus Point for Hand of Harm. You can still use Hand of Harm only once per turn.
- Timing: Triggered (when using Flurry of Blows)
- Prerequisites: Level 11; CLS-523 (Hand of Harm), CLS-524 (Hand of Healing)
- Limits: Hand of Harm still usable only once per turn.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus), CLS-523 (Hand of Harm), CLS-524 (Hand of Healing)

name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 Focus Points. The creature then returns to life with a number of Hit Points equal to 4d10 plus your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died with any of the following conditions, the creature revives with the conditions removed: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned.
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 17
- Limits: Corpse must have died within the past 24 hours; costs 5 Focus Points. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Shadow Arts
text:
- Rule Text: You have learned to draw on the power of the Shadowfell, gaining the following benefits. Darkness. You can expend 1 Focus Point to cast the *Darkness* spell without spell components. You can see within the spell's area when you cast it with this feature. While the spell persists, you can move its area of Darkness to a space within 60 feet of yourself at the start of each of your turns. Darkvision. You gain Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet. Shadowy Figments. You know the *Minor Illusion* spell. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.
- Timing: Passive (Darkvision, Shadowy Figments); casting *Darkness* per the spell.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Casting *Darkness* this way costs 1 Focus Point.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)
- Related Rules: *Darkness* (spell), *Minor Illusion* (spell)

name: Shadow Step
text:
- Rule Text: While entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. You then have Advantage on the next melee attack you make before the end of the current turn.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: You must be entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, and the destination must also be in Dim Light or Darkness.
- Exceptions: CLS-531 (Improved Shadow Step) can waive the lighting requirement.

name: Improved Shadow Step
text:
- Rule Text: When you use your Shadow Step, you can expend 1 Focus Point to remove the requirement that you must start and end in Dim Light or Darkness for that use of the feature. As part of this Bonus Action, you can make an Unarmed Strike immediately after you teleport.
- Timing: Bonus Action (with Shadow Step)
- Prerequisites: Level 11; CLS-530 (Shadow Step)
- Limits: Costs 1 Focus Point to remove the lighting requirement.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus), CLS-530 (Shadow Step)
- Exceptions: Overrides the lighting requirement of CLS-530 (Shadow Step) for that use.

name: Cloak of Shadows
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action while entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can expend 3 Focus Points to shroud yourself with shadows for 1 minute, until you have the Incapacitated condition, or until you end your turn in Bright Light. While shrouded, you gain: Invisibility — you have the Invisible condition. Partially Incorporeal — you can move through occupied spaces as if they were Difficult Terrain; if you end your turn in such a space, you are shunted to the last unoccupied space you were in. Shadow Flurry — you can use your Flurry of Blows without expending any Focus Points.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: 1 minute, until you have the Incapacitated condition, or until you end your turn in Bright Light
- Prerequisites: Level 17
- Limits: Must be entirely within Dim Light or Darkness to activate; costs 3 Focus Points.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Elemental Attunement
text:
- Rule Text: At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Focus Point to imbue yourself with elemental energy. The energy lasts for 10 minutes or until you have the Incapacitated condition. While active you gain: Reach — when you make an Unarmed Strike, your reach is 10 feet greater than normal. Elemental Strikes — whenever you hit with your Unarmed Strike, you can cause it to deal your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage rather than its normal damage type; when you deal one of these types with it, you can also force the target to make a Strength saving throw, and on a failed save you can move the target up to 10 feet toward or away from you.
- Timing: Triggered (start of your turn)
- Duration: 10 minutes or until you have the Incapacitated condition
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Costs 1 Focus Point.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Manipulate Elements
text:
- Rule Text: You know the *Elementalism* spell. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.
- Timing: Passive (spell known)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Related Rules: *Elementalism* (spell)

name: Elemental Burst
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend 2 Focus Points to cause elemental energy to burst in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of yourself. Choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Each creature in the Sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes damage of the chosen type equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.
- Timing: Magic action
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Costs 2 Focus Points. 20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Stride of the Elements
text:
- Rule Text: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you also have a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
- Timing: Passive (while CLS-533 is active)
- Prerequisites: Level 11; CLS-533 (Elemental Attunement)
- Interactions: CLS-533 (Elemental Attunement)

name: Elemental Epitome
text:
- Rule Text: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you also gain: Damage Resistance — you gain Resistance to one of the following damage types of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder; at the start of each of your turns, you can change this choice. Destructive Stride — when you use your Step of the Wind, your Speed increases by 20 feet until the end of the turn; for that duration, any creature of your choice takes damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die when you enter a space within 5 feet of it (damage type your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder; a creature can take this damage only once per turn). Empowered Strikes — once on each of your turns, you can deal extra damage to a target equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die when you hit it with an Unarmed Strike (the extra damage is the same type dealt by that strike).
- Timing: Passive (while CLS-533 is active); Destructive Stride is Triggered (when you use Step of the Wind)
- Prerequisites: Level 17; CLS-533 (Elemental Attunement)
- Limits: Destructive Stride damage once per turn per creature; Empowered Strikes once on each of your turns.
- Interactions: CLS-533 (Elemental Attunement), CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Open Hand Technique
text:
- Rule Text: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target. Addle. The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. Push. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you. Topple. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with a Flurry of Blows attack)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus — Flurry of Blows)

name: Wholeness of Body
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can roll your Martial Arts die and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained).
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Prerequisites: Level 6
- Limits: Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once); regain all expended uses on a Long Rest.

name: Fleet Step
text:
- Rule Text: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.
- Timing: Triggered (after you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind)
- Prerequisites: Level 11
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Quivering Palm
text:
- Rule Text: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start imperceptible lethal vibrations in its body, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you take an action to end them; alternatively, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations. To end them, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you end them, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. You can end the vibrations harmlessly (no action required).
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with an Unarmed Strike) to start; ending is an action, or forgo one attack of the Attack action.
- Duration: A number of days equal to your Monk level
- Prerequisites: Level 17
- Limits: Costs 4 Focus Points. You can have only one creature under the effect at a time. You and the target must be on the same plane of existence to end the vibrations.
- Interactions: CLS-503 (Monk's Focus)

name: Lay On Hands
text:
- Rule Text: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of Hit Points equal to five times your Paladin level. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and draw power from the pool of healing to restore a number of Hit Points to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool. You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Limits: Pool = five times Paladin level (in Hit Points); replenishes on a Long Rest. Removing Poisoned costs 5 Hit Points from the pool and does not also restore Hit Points.
- Interactions: CLS-616 (Restoring Touch adds condition removal to this feature)

name: Spellcasting (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: You can cast spells through prayer and meditation, using Paladin spells from the Paladin spell list. Spell Slots: the Paladin Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells; you regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: you prepare the list of level 1+ spells available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Paladin spells (*Heroism* and *Searing Smite* are recommended). The number of spells on your list equals the Prepared Spells column of the Paladin Features table; whenever that number increases, choose additional Paladin spells until your list matches the number. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. If another Paladin feature gives you spells you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number you can prepare here, but otherwise count as Paladin spells for you. Changing Your Prepared Spells: whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one spell on your list with another Paladin spell for which you have spell slots. Spellcasting Ability: Charisma. Spellcasting Focus: you can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus for your Paladin spells.
- Timing: Passive (preparation); spellcasting per each spell
- Limits: Prepared Spells = Prepared Spells column (2–15 by level); spell slots per the Features table; regain all slots on a Long Rest; replace one prepared spell per Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-605 (Paladin's Smite — *Divine Smite* always prepared), CLS-611 (Faithful Steed — *Find Steed* always prepared)
- Related Rules: Paladin Spell List (below); chapter 7 spellcasting rules

name: Weapon Mastery (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Longswords and Javelins. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Two kinds of weapons (you must have proficiency); change choices on a Long Rest.
- Related Rules: weapon mastery properties (Chapter 6)

name: Fighting Style (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below. Blessed Warrior: you learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice (*Guidance* and *Sacred Flame* are recommended). The chosen cantrips count as Paladin spells for you, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 2)
- Related Rules: Fighting Style feats (Chapter 5); *Guidance*, *Sacred Flame* and Cleric cantrips (Chapter 7)

name: Paladin's Smite
text:
- Rule Text: You always have the *Divine Smite* spell prepared. In addition, you can cast it without expending a spell slot, but you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.
- Timing: Passive (always prepared); casting per the spell
- Limits: One free (no-slot) casting of *Divine Smite* per Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-602 (Spellcasting)
- Related Rules: *Divine Smite* (Paladin Spell List, level 1)

name: Channel Divinity (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes, using it to fuel magical effects. You start with one such effect: Divine Sense. Other Paladin features give additional Channel Divinity effect options. Each time you use this class's Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You can use this class's Channel Divinity twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain an additional use when you reach Paladin level 11. If a Channel Divinity effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals the spell save DC from this class's Spellcasting feature.
- Timing: Varies by effect (Divine Sense is a Bonus Action)
- Limits: 2 uses (3 at level 11); regain 1 on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-607 (Divine Sense), CLS-613 (Abjure Foes), and subclass Channel Divinity options
- Related Rules: CLS-602 (Spellcasting — save DC source)

name: Divine Sense
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can open your awareness to detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead. For the next 10 minutes or until you have the Incapacitated condition, you know the location of any creature of those types within 60 feet of yourself, and you know its creature type. Within the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place or object that has been consecrated or desecrated, as with the *Hallow* spell.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 10 minutes or until you have the Incapacitated condition
- Limits: Range 60 feet; expends a use of Channel Divinity.
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity)
- Related Rules: *Hallow* spell

name: Paladin Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Paladin subclass of your choice: the Oath of Devotion, Oath of Glory, Oath of the Ancients, or Oath of Vengeance. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Paladin levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Paladin level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Paladin levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, and 16.
- Related Rules: Ability Score Improvement feat (Chapter 5)

name: Extra Attack (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)

name: Faithful Steed
text:
- Rule Text: You can call on the aid of an otherworldly steed. You always have the *Find Steed* spell prepared. You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Passive (always prepared); casting per the spell
- Limits: One free (no-slot) casting of *Find Steed* per Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-602 (Spellcasting)
- Related Rules: *Find Steed* (Paladin Spell List, level 2)

name: Aura of Protection
text:
- Rule Text: You radiate a protective, unseeable aura in a 10-foot Emanation that originates from you. The aura is inactive while you have the Incapacitated condition. You and your allies in the aura gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1). If another Paladin is present, a creature can benefit from only one Aura of Protection at a time; the creature chooses which aura while in them.
- Timing: Passive
- Duration: Inactive while you have the Incapacitated condition.
- Limits: 10-foot Emanation (becomes 30 feet via CLS-617). Saving throw bonus = Charisma modifier (minimum +1). Only one Aura of Protection benefits a creature at a time.
- Interactions: CLS-614 (Aura of Courage), CLS-617 (Aura Expansion), subclass aura features (CLS-621, CLS-622, CLS-623, CLS-627, CLS-632, CLS-634, CLS-639)
- Exceptions: CLS-617 (Aura Expansion increases the Emanation to 30 feet)

name: Abjure Foes
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of this class's Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. As you present your Holy Symbol or weapon, you can target a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While Frightened in this way, a target can do only one of the following on its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: 1 minute or until the target takes any damage (Frightened)
- Limits: Targets = Charisma modifier (minimum 1) within 60 feet; expends one use of Channel Divinity. Save DC = Paladin spell save DC.
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity)

name: Aura of Courage
text:
- Rule Text: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Frightened ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
- Timing: Passive
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Radiant Strikes
text:
- Rule Text: Your strikes now carry supernatural power. When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.
- Timing: Triggered (on a hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike)

name: Restoring Touch
text:
- Rule Text: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. You must expend 5 Hit Points from the healing pool of Lay On Hands for each of these conditions you remove; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.
- Timing: Triggered (when you use Lay On Hands)
- Limits: 5 Hit Points from the Lay On Hands pool per condition removed; those points do not also restore Hit Points.
- Interactions: CLS-601 (Lay On Hands)

name: Aura Expansion
text:
- Rule Text: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.
- Timing: Passive (level 18)
- Exceptions: Overrides the 10-foot Emanation of CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Epic Boon (Paladin)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Truesight is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: Epic Boon feats (Chapter 5)

name: Oath of Devotion Spells
text:
- Rule Text: The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-602 (Spellcasting)

name: Sacred Weapon
text:
- Rule Text: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon that you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes or until you use this feature again, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls you make with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), and each time you hit with it, you cause it to deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage. The weapon also emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond that. You can end this effect early (no action required). This effect also ends if you aren't carrying the weapon.
- Timing: Triggered (when you take the Attack action)
- Duration: 10 minutes, until you use this feature again, until you end it (no action required), or until you aren't carrying the weapon
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends one use of Channel Divinity. Attack bonus = Charisma modifier (minimum +1).
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity)

name: Aura of Devotion
text:
- Rule Text: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Smite of Protection
text:
- Rule Text: Your magical smite now radiates protective energy. Whenever you cast *Divine Smite*, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.
- Timing: Triggered (when you cast *Divine Smite*)
- Duration: Until the start of your next turn
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)
- Related Rules: *Divine Smite*

name: Holy Nimbus
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Holy Ward: you have Advantage on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead. Radiant Damage: whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, that creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. Sunlight: the aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required)
- Prerequisites: Level 20
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Inspiring Smite
text:
- Rule Text: Immediately after you cast *Divine Smite*, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity and distribute Temporary Hit Points to creatures of your choice within 30 feet of yourself, which can include you. The total number of Temporary Hit Points equals 2d8 plus your Paladin level, divided among the chosen creatures however you like.
- Timing: Triggered (immediately after you cast *Divine Smite*)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends one use of Channel Divinity. Total Temporary Hit Points = 2d8 + Paladin level.
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity)
- Related Rules: *Divine Smite*

name: Oath of Glory Spells
text:
- Rule Text: The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Glory Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-602 (Spellcasting)

name: Peerless Athlete
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to augment your athleticism. For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and the distance of your Long and High Jumps increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal).
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 1 hour
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends one use of Channel Divinity.
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity)

name: Aura of Alacrity
text:
- Rule Text: Your Speed increases by 10 feet. In addition, whenever an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, the ally's Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.
- Timing: Passive
- Duration: Ally bonus lasts until the end of their next turn.
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Glorious Defense
text:
- Rule Text: You can turn defense into a sudden strike. When you or another creature you can see within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to grant a bonus to the target's AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). If the attack misses, you can make one attack with a weapon against the attacker as part of this Reaction if the attacker is within your weapon's range. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Reaction (when you or a creature within 10 feet is hit by an attack roll)
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Limits: AC bonus = Charisma modifier (minimum +1). Uses = Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

name: Living Legend
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Charismatic: you are blessed with an otherworldly presence and have Advantage on all Charisma checks. Saving Throw Reroll: if you fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reroll it; you must use this new roll. Unerring Strike: once on each of your turns when you make an attack roll with a weapon and miss, you can cause that attack to hit instead.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 10 minutes
- Prerequisites: Level 20
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Unerring Strike: once on each of your turns.

name: Nature's Wrath
text:
- Rule Text: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to conjure spectral vines around nearby creatures. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of yourself must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute. A Restrained creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
- Timing: Magic action
- Duration: 1 minute (Restrained; save ends at end of each of the creature's turns)
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Targets within 15 feet; expends one use of Channel Divinity. Save DC = Paladin spell save DC.
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity)

name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
text:
- Rule Text: The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of the Ancients Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-602 (Spellcasting)

name: Aura of Warding
text:
- Rule Text: Ancient magic lies so heavily upon you that it forms an eldritch ward, blunting energy from beyond the Material Plane; you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage while in your Aura of Protection.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 7
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Undying Sentinel
text:
- Rule Text: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead, and you regain a number of Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. Additionally, you can't be aged magically, and you cease visibly aging.
- Timing: Triggered (when reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright)
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Limits: Once per Long Rest. Hit Points regained = three times Paladin level.

name: Elder Champion
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with primal power, granting the benefits below for 1 minute or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Diminish Defiance: enemies in the aura have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options. Regeneration: at the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 Hit Points. Swift Spells: whenever you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can cast it using a Bonus Action instead.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 1 minute or until you end it (no action required)
- Prerequisites: Level 20
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
text:
- Rule Text: The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Vengeance Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
- Timing: Passive
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Interactions: CLS-602 (Spellcasting)

name: Vow of Enmity
text:
- Rule Text: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can transfer the vow to a different creature within 30 feet of yourself (no action required).
- Timing: Triggered (when you take the Attack action)
- Duration: 1 minute or until you use this feature again
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Limits: Expends one use of Channel Divinity. Target/transfer within 30 feet.
- Interactions: CLS-606 (Channel Divinity), CLS-638 (Soul of Vengeance)

name: Relentless Avenger
text:
- Rule Text: Your supernatural focus helps you close off a foe's retreat. When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce the creature's Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn. You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Timing: Triggered (when you hit with an Opportunity Attack), as part of that Reaction
- Duration: Target's Speed reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn
- Prerequisites: Level 7

name: Soul of Vengeance
text:
- Rule Text: Immediately after a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against that creature if it's within range.
- Timing: Reaction (after a Vow of Enmity creature hits or misses with an attack roll)
- Prerequisites: Level 15
- Interactions: CLS-636 (Vow of Enmity)

name: Avenging Angel
text:
- Rule Text: As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Flight: you sprout spectral wings on your back, have a Fly Speed of 60 feet, and can hover. Frightful Aura: whenever an enemy starts its turn in your Aura of Protection, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. Attack rolls against the Frightened creature have Advantage.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required)
- Prerequisites: Level 20
- Limits: Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). Save DC = Paladin spell save DC.
- Interactions: CLS-612 (Aura of Protection)

name: Spellcasting (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: You cast Ranger spells using the rules in chapter 7. Spell Slots: The Ranger Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells; regain all expended slots on a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+: Prepare the list of level 1+ spells available to cast with this feature; to start, choose two level 1 Ranger spells (*Cure Wounds* and *Ensnaring Strike* recommended). The number of spells on your list increases per the Prepared Spells column; when it increases, choose additional Ranger spells until the number on your list matches the table. Chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots (e.g., a level 5 Ranger's list can include six Ranger spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination). If another Ranger feature gives you spells you always have prepared, those don't count against the number you can prepare here, but otherwise count as Ranger spells for you. Changing Your Prepared Spells: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one spell on your list with another Ranger spell for which you have spell slots. Spellcasting Ability: Wisdom. Spellcasting Focus: You can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Ranger spells.
- Timing: Passive (preparation); spell casting per individual spell
- Limits: Prepared spells = Prepared Spells column; spell slots per Spell Slots columns; replace one prepared spell per Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-702 (Favored Enemy — always-prepared *Hunter's Mark*); CLS-705 (Fighting Style — Druidic Warrior)
- Related Rules: Ranger Spell List (below); Chapter 7 spellcasting rules

name: Favored Enemy
text:
- Rule Text: You always have the *Hunter's Mark* spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest. The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Ranger levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the Ranger Features table.
- Timing: Passive (always prepared); casting per *Hunter's Mark*
- Limits: Free castings per Favored Enemy column (2 at level 1, up to 6); regain all expended uses on a Long Rest.
- Interactions: CLS-701 (Spellcasting)
- Related Rules: *Hunter's Mark* (spell)

name: Weapon Mastery (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Longbows and Shortswords. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose (for example, switching to the mastery properties of Scimitars and Longswords).
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Two kinds of weapons; change choices on a Long Rest.
- Related Rules: Weapon mastery properties (Chapter 6)

name: Deft Explorer
text:
- Rule Text: You gain the following benefits. Expertise: Choose one of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise; you gain Expertise in that skill. Languages: You know two languages of your choice from the language tables in chapter 2.
- Timing: Passive
- Interactions: CLS-710 (Expertise)

name: Fighting Style (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see chapter 5). Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below. Druidic Warrior: You learn two Druid cantrips of your choice (see the Druid class's section for a list of Druid spells); *Guidance* and *Starry Wisp* are recommended. The chosen cantrips count as Ranger spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Druid cantrip.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Druidic Warrior grants two Druid cantrips; replace one per Ranger level gained.
- Interactions: CLS-701 (Spellcasting)
- Related Rules: Fighting Style feats (Chapter 5)

name: Ranger Subclass
text:
- Rule Text: You gain a Ranger subclass of your choice: Beast Master, Fey Wanderer, Gloom Stalker, or Hunter. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Ranger levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Ranger level or lower.
- Timing: Passive (gained at level 3)

name: Ability Score Improvement (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Ranger levels 8, 12, and 16.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: At levels 4, 8, 12, 16.
- Related Rules: Ability Score Improvement feat (Chapter 5)

name: Extra Attack (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
- Timing: Passive (modifies the Attack action)

name: Roving
text:
- Rule Text: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
- Timing: Passive
- Limits: Speed increase only while not wearing Heavy armor.

name: Expertise (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: Choose two of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in those skills.
- Timing: Passive
- Interactions: CLS-704 (Deft Explorer)

name: Tireless
text:
- Rule Text: Primal power fuels you on your journeys, granting the following benefits. Temporary Hit Points: As a Magic action, you can give yourself Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1); you can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Decrease Exhaustion: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.
- Timing: Magic action (Temporary Hit Points); Passive (Decrease Exhaustion, on Short Rest)
- Limits: Temporary HP uses = Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per Long Rest.

name: Relentless Hunter
text:
- Rule Text: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on *Hunter's Mark*.
- Timing: Passive
- Related Rules: *Hunter's Mark* (spell)

name: Nature's Veil
text:
- Rule Text: You invoke spirits of nature to magically hide yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can give yourself the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
- Timing: Bonus Action
- Duration: Until the end of your next turn
- Limits: Uses = Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per Long Rest.

name: Precise Hunter
text:
- Rule Text: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your *Hunter's Mark*.
- Timing: Passive
- Related Rules: *Hunter's Mark* (spell)

name: Feral Senses
text:
- Rule Text: Your connection to the forces of nature grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.
- Timing: Passive

name: Epic Boon (Ranger)
text:
- Rule Text: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see chapter 5) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Dimensional Travel is recommended.
- Timing: Passive (level 19)
- Related Rules: Epic Boon feats (Chapter 5)

name: Foe Slayer
text:
- Rule Text: The damage die of your *Hunter's Mark* is a d10 rather than a d6.
- Timing: Passive (level 20)
- Exceptions: Overrides the damage die of *Hunter's Mark*.
- Related Rules: *Hunter's Mark* (spell)

name: Primal Companion
text:
- Rule Text: You magically summon a primal beast, which draws strength from your bond with nature. Choose its stat block: Beast of the Land, Beast of the Sea, or Beast of the Sky. You also determine the kind of animal it is, choosing a kind appropriate for the stat block. The beast is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands; it vanishes if you die. The Beast in Combat: The beast acts during your turn. It can move and use its Reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the Dodge action unless you take a Bonus Action to command it to take an action in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the Attack action to command the beast to take the Beast's Strike action. If you have the Incapacitated condition, the beast acts on its own and isn't limited to the Dodge action. Restoring or Replacing the Beast: If the beast has died within the last hour, you can take a Magic action to touch it and expend a spell slot; the beast returns to life after 1 minute with all its Hit Points restored. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can summon a different primal beast, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you; you choose its stat block and appearance. If you already have a beast from this feature, the old one vanishes when the new one appears.
- Prerequisites: Level 3
- Timing: Passive (beast acts on your turn); Bonus Action to command; Magic action (restore); summon on Long Rest
- Limits: One beast at a time; restore only if died within the last hour and by expending a spell slot.
- Interactions: CLS-719 (Exceptional Training), CLS-720 (Bestial Fury), CLS-721 (Share Spells)

#### Beast of the Land
*Medium Beast, Neutral*

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| AC | 13 plus your Wisdom modifier |
| HP | 5 plus five times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Ranger level) |
| Speed | 40 ft., Climb 40 ft. |
| Senses | Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12 |
| Languages | Understands the languages you know |
| CR | None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus) |

| Ability | Score | Mod | Save |

| STR | 14 | +2 | +2 |
| DEX | 14 | +2 | +2 |
| CON | 15 | +2 | +2 |
